subject: Promo code pool allocation for 'LLM in Production' roadshow — final confirmation
messages:
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@brightwaveevents.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jul 2025 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Request: promo code pool for 'LLM in Production' — NYC roadshow (Oct)

Hi Mina,

We're lining up sponsors and attendee perks for the NYC leg of our 'LLM in Production' roadshow (Oct 14-15). Redwood has been a great partner — we'd love to offer attendees a sample of your platform via promo codes.

As a starting ask: can Redwood provide a pool of 300 promo credits (usable toward API usage / trial extension) and 100 single-use trial-extension codes (30-day extended trial)? We'll promote Redwood as a featured sponsor, include logo placement, and mention a short blurb in the session description.

Key questions:
- Can you confirm the number and type of codes you can allocate?
- Are there any redemption windows or usage limits we should be aware of?
- Timeline: we need the codes delivered no later than Sep 15 so we can bake them into event materials.

I've attached a draft SOW and a one-pager on the attendee journey. Happy to hop on a 20-min call if that's easier.

Thanks,
Sarah Nguyen
Partnerships Manager, BrightWave Events
Attachments: SOW-draft.pdf (pdf), attendee_onepager.pdf (pdf)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@brightwaveevents.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: promo code pool for 'LLM in Production' — NYC roadshow (Oct)

Hi Sarah — thanks for the note and the SOW. We love the event concept.

High-level: I'll route this through our promo budget/partnership approvals and circle back with a firm yes/no by end of week. A few quick clarifying items that will speed approvals:
- Can you confirm attendee count for the NYC event and expected redemption rate (if you have historical benchmarks)?
- Do you want the credits as a single bulk code (e.g., redeemable by attendees against a single pool) or as many single-use codes?
- For the trial-extension codes: are these distributed to attendees only or available via post-event follow-up?

Tentatively we can offer: 250 platform-credit units + 50 trial-extension codes (30d), delivered as CSV of single-use codes, with redemption window Oct 14–Dec 14 (60 days). I'll confirm pricing/terms internally.

I CC'd Ben (partner ops) and Dylan (growth) to confirm tracking needs and any constraints.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Head of Partnerships (acting), Redwood Inference
Attachments: —

Subject: Fwd: Request: promo code pool for 'LLM in Production' — NYC roadshow (Oct)

Ben / Dylan — Sarah from BrightWave is asking for a pool for the NYC roadshow. Draft ask below. My initial thinking: approve 250 credits + 50 extension codes, single-use CSV, redemption window 60 days, require attendee email capture and a lead form link so we can tie redemptions back to HubSpot.

Ben: can you confirm this fits the regional promo budget? Any reason to push for more restrictive caps (per-account cap, only first-time orgs)?
Dylan: can we add UTM tracking to the code landing so analytics picks it up? Also thinking we should request the event organizers to collect company name and email on claim.

Ben Carter replied:
> Mina — sounds reasonable. Approve 250 credits + 50 extensions. Add per-org cap of 50 credits to avoid a single team consuming the pool. Budget code: PARTNER-BWE-0725.

Dylan Brooks replied:
> Agree. We'll provision single-use codes and a landing page with UTM params (utm_source=brightwave&utm_campaign=roadshow_nyc). Ask Sarah to send the attendee list if they want codes pre-assigned; otherwise we'll provide a CSV for them to drop into their registration system.

I'll finalize and send Sarah the CSV and SOW next week.

Mina
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@brightwaveevents.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jul 2025 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: promo code pool for 'LLM in Production' — NYC roadshow (Oct)

Hi Sarah — thanks for waiting. Confirming Redwood will provide:

- 250 single-use promo credits (each code unlocks a small credit package; aggregate budget = 250 credits).
- 50 single-use 30-day trial-extension codes.
- Per-org redemption cap: 50 credits max.
- Redemption window: Oct 14, 2025 — Dec 14, 2025.

I've attached the CSV (promo_codes_list.csv) with the single-use codes and a short README (format/expiry). We've also attached a redlined SOW — please sign the DocuSign link below so our legal team can finalize.

Redemption & tracking notes:
- Please ensure each code is claimed with an email address; the form should capture company name and role for lead qualification.
- We'll add UTM parameters for the event landing (utm_source=brightwave&utm_campaign=roadshow_nyc) so traffic attribution shows up in our analytics.
- If you want codes pre-assigned to registrants, send the attendee CSV (email + company) and we'll map codes to emails.

Next steps:
1) Sign SOW via DocuSign: https://docusign.com/req/ABC-987654
2) If you want pre-assigned codes, send attendee list by Sep 10.
3) Confirm where you'd like the CSV delivered (email vs secure Drive link).

Thanks — excited to partner on this.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Head of Partnerships (acting) | Redwood Inference
Attachments: promo_codes_list.csv (csv), SOW-draft.pdf (pdf)
